name: Amagi Shien
source:
Kimido Fumi is a popular mystery writer. But she also solves incidents in real life. In a local ryokan she is asked to investigate the death of a man.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-february-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
君户文美是一名受欢迎的推理小说作家，但她也会在现实生活中解决案件。她在当地一家日式旅馆接到委托，调查一名男子的死亡。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-february-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
